item.title: Families of plane crash victims ask US appeals court to revive a criminal case against Boeing
item.description: The families maintain prosecutors violated their rights by failing to consult them properly.

item.title: Here’s how to watch the CT athletes in the 2026 Winter Olympic Games
item.description: Connecticut will have a number of athletes competing for Team USA at the 2026 Winter Olympics in Italy. Here's a breakdown of who's competing, when, and where you can watch them on TV or streaming.

item.title: Republicans reject complaint about Gabbard as Democrats question time it took to see it
item.description: The top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee said he will keep looking into it.

item.title: Census Bureau plans to use survey with a citizenship question in its test for 2030, alarming experts
item.description: The ACS includes a citizenship question while the census form does not.

item.title: Waterbury police sergeant facing criminal charges, placed on administrative leave
item.description: Police said he was processed on charges of interfering with an investigation and fifth-degree computer crimes on Thursday and released on a promise to appear.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 06, 2026
item.description: Gentle words can still carry real weight. At midday, the Moon squares expansive Jupiter, stretching patience as feelings bump against limits in family matters or group efforts. By 5:48 pm EST, talkative Mercury steps into Pisces, which reminds us to encourage one another's exploration of imagination. With Mercury leveling up our empathy, we can mend misunderstandings, revive stalled conversations, and let intuition guide timing. Progress sticks when compassion ensures that everyone gets heard. C

item.title: Man arrested after alleged assault victim, dead puppies found in U-Haul outside CT motel
item.description: A man is facing charges after police found three dogs, four dead puppies and 19-year-old woman in a U-Haul outside of a Groton motel.

item.title: A funeral home stashed 189 decaying bodies and handed out fake ashes. His mother was among them
item.description: The funeral home owners gave families fake ashes for years, trying to conceal the bodies.

item.title: CT man charged with assault after allegedly stabbing man multiple times during altercation
item.description: Police allege that he became involved in an argument with another man and stabbed him with a knife multiple times.

item.title: CT high school student arrested after alleged discovery of gun, marijuana in backpack
item.description: Police said a student allegedly heard another student talking about a "clip" in the bathroom and immediately reported it to a school administrator.
